description: The Folders window lists the data folders under the Epicenter folder root and opens each with the page's own engine. Listing permits the window into each folder's scope; the folder plugin then grants it the directory and reads and changes it. It opens Todos, Capture, Honeycrisp, or Whispering, which Epicenter bundles, on the app's default folder or a listed one (open_bundled_app), and opens Settings (ADR-0537). The window listens for the folder plugin's change event, epicenter-folder://changed, and for the shell's epicenter://data-folders-changed, sent when the list of data folders may have changed. Its page is served on the epicenter-app scheme, so the capability is local (ADR-0561).
